backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.hint: Exports an encrypted snapshot of the whole vault, protected by the master password. The file name carries no sensitive data. Restore overwrites the current vault and keeps the old file as a backup.
backup.dataDirHint: Manual backup: lock or quit first, then copy the vault file to a USB drive; unlock with the same master password on another machine.
backup.importConfirm: Restore will overwrite the current vault; the existing file is kept as a backup. Continue?
